title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1124 | 会发光的豪猪、小小发明家、巨型圣诞树
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🦔 墨西哥有一种豪猪，紫光一照，浑身的刺会发出绿光，小脚丫还会变黄！
🎲 美国小朋友发明玩具大赛：三年级姐姐和一年级妹妹用“口袋小家庭”游戏拿了奖！
🎄 纽约巨型圣诞树有七十六英尺高，十二月二日将点亮五万盏灯！

📖 Word of the day: glow（发光；闪耀）

🎮 谜语：白天看不见、晚上会发光，没有插头、住在墨西哥树上、浑身是刺——我是谁？答案：会发光的豪猪！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🦔 In Mexico, a little porcupine's quills glow green and blue under purple light, and its feet glow yellow!
🎲 Two little sisters won a prize at a toy contest in Chicago with their game Pocket Fam!
🎄 New York's giant Christmas tree is seventy six feet tall and will light up with fifty thousand lights on December second!

📖 Word of the day: glow

🎮 Riddle: I shine in the dark but I have no plug. I live in a tree in Mexico, and I am covered in spikes. What am I? A glowing porcupine!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. glow（发光；闪耀）
When something glows, it gives off soft light.
例：The porcupine glows under purple light.（豪猪在紫光下会发光。）

2. inventor（发明家）
An inventor is a person who makes up a brand new thing.
例：Ruby is a young inventor!（露比是一位小发明家！）

3. spruce（云杉）
A spruce is a tall tree with pointy green needles.
例：The Christmas tree is a spruce.（这棵圣诞树是一棵云杉。）

4. quill（尖刺）
A quill is a sharp, pointy spine on a porcupine.
例：The porcupine has sharp quills!（豪猪身上有尖尖的刺！）
